description: Execute SQL scripts on selected datasource with transaction support

datasource_selector.info: Select the datasource where the SQL script will be executed

enable_transaction.info: Execute all statements within a single transaction. Rollback on any error.

statement_separator.info: Character used to separate multiple SQL statements (default: semicolon)

continue_on_error.info: Continue executing remaining statements even if one fails (only when transaction is disabled)
